## F — Intersections and interchange layouts
Research index: 33 original C facts and 18 continuation or confusable C2 facts cover Intersections and interchange layouts.
Exam index: part A cites cover edition, publisher frontmatter and the physical testing page; no passing percentage or time limit is asserted.
VERIFY: ID-INTERSECTIONS-PERCENT — official percentage not printed; ID-INTERSECTIONS-TIME — official time limit unlocated; ID-INTERSECTIONS-EFFECTIVE — effective date unestablished.
VERIFY: ID-INTERSECTIONS-DYNAMIC — Installed signals, crossing status and local interchange directions control the actual trip. No timetable, active train location or site-specific signal timing is invented.
VERIFY: ID-INTERSECTIONS-MARKET — demand research missing; ID-INTERSECTIONS-COMPETITORS — competitor research missing.
VERIFY: ID-INTERSECTIONS-RISK-STATISTIC — The railroad crash-risk multiplier on physical page sixty is an undated statistical claim without a study reference in the excerpt; it is withheld as a current measured comparison.
Every open item stays assigned to the evidence or research owner in its originating chunk. Pedagogic priorities are not official topic weights.
VERIFY: ID-INTERSECTION-BICYCLE-SPAN — The opening bicycle straight-through instruction continues from physical page fifty-nine. The full antecedent and movement condition are not forced into a single-page fact; the complete cross-page disposition remains open.
VERIFY: ID-INTERSECTION-DIAGRAM-COVERAGE — The interchange route diagrams have not been rendered or cleared for learner spatial-recognition media. Only the explicitly written route instructions are represented; no image-based route is invented.
